meta.title: Submit a bid on a Tech+RFQ, commercial stage after the technical response
gaps: Directly assert that Master QCS displays the commercial price next to the technical result.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Directly assert that Master QCS displays the commercial price next to the technical result.

plan.title: Vendor submits commercial bid after technical response

steps.note: Open the prepared Tech+RFQ event on its technical stage.
Continue in the Vendor A supplier-portal session while leaving the buyer session open.
Open the event's technical round to confirm the prior technical response is submitted.
Assert that Vendor A's technical response is already submitted before commercial bidding.
Open the RFQ pricing stage after the technical response.
Accept required terms as needed, enter the ₹100 quote, and submit it.
Assert that the RFQ bid was accepted and the vendor portal shows it as submitted.
Return to the buyer's event page to inspect the commercial response.
Open the buyer's Master QCS comparison grid.
Assert that the submitted vendor appears as a real vendor column.
Assert that the commercial price is shown as ₹100 in Master QCS.
